season_weather_time.note: Storm/thunder and impermanence-time language are retained as source temporal/weather evidence.

economy.note: Repeated giving to learned persons, singers and followers is direct patronage/gift evidence; no wider market system is inferred.

communities_social_groups.note: Exact `அந்தணர்`, `பாடுநர்` and `பாணர்` are retained as source roles/groups without later identity substitution.

religion_ritual.note: `கூற்றம்` and `வேள்வி அந்தணர்` are retained as source death-agent/ritual language without later deity, sectarian or doctrinal mapping.

knowledge_technology.note: `கேள்வி முற்றிய` and `முழுதுஉணர் கேள்வியன்` are retained as source learned/knowledge qualities.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Generosity and recognized impermanence are retained as the poem's own evaluative concepts.

textual_intertextual_relationships.note: Printed `பாடியவர், பாடப்பட்டோர், திணை, துறை தெரிந்தில.` explicitly records unresolved attribution/classification; it is not converted into a person or a thinai/thurai classification.

empty_notes.tinai_turai: Thinai and thurai are explicitly unresolved in the printed source; no classification is manufactured.
empty_notes.named_entities: The frozen attribution field is a non-identification statement, not a named person/entity.

communities_social_groups.note: Exact `அந்தணாளர்` is preserved as source terminology; no later caste/community equivalence is imposed.

religion_ritual.note: `பலிபெறு முரசம்`, `அந்தணாளர்`, `நான்மறை` and `உயர்ந்தோர் நாடு` remain source ritual/other-world vocabulary without later doctrinal expansion.

knowledge_technology.note: `நான்மறை` and discernment language are retained as source knowledge evidence without external textual identification.

economy.note: Rule/possession and transfer of countries are retained as source resource/political-economic language, not a modeled economy.

communities_social_groups.note: Exact `இழி பிறப்பினோன்` is retained as the poem's printed social/funerary wording without later caste or hierarchy equivalence.

religion_ritual.note: Cremation-ground, food-offering and renunciation language are retained as source funerary/ethical ritual evidence without importing a later religious system.

values_ethical_concepts.note: Mortality, impermanence and acting before the painful final day are retained as the poem's own ethical language.

communities_social_groups.note: Singer, `பாணன்` and supplicant terms are retained exactly as source social categories.

family_gender_kinship.note: The woman-comparison and personified `நிலமகள்` are retained as gender/personification evidence, not literal biography or kinship.
